mapper.select: SELECT p.profile_id, p.email, p.username, p.password, p.full_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.phone_number, p.is_deleted, r.role_name, s.shop_name FROM profiles p INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = p.role_id LEFT JOIN profile_shops ps ON ps.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shops s ON s.shop_id = ps.shop_id AND s.is_deleted = false WHERE p.profile_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.is_deleted = false

SELECT p.profile_id, p.email, p.username, p.password, p.full_name, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.phone_number, p.is_deleted, r.role_name, s.shop_name FROM profiles p INNER JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = p.role_id LEFT JOIN profile_shops ps ON ps.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shops s ON s.shop_id = ps.shop_id AND s.is_deleted = false WHERE p.email = #{email} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.is_deleted = false
